format: single Servpro associate license (one territory of 50,000 to 80,000 population, home/office based, at least 1 vehicle)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Servpro franchise for an associate license is from $263,305 to $385,570. This includes $212,000 that must be paid to the franchisor or its affiliate.

fee.quote: The Standard Purchase Price is $212,000. It includes an initial franchise license fee of $100,000 and a standard Equipment and Products Package costing $112,000. The minimum initial franchise fee is $100,000.
fee.note: The $112,000 Equipment and Products Package must be bought from a franchisor affiliate at signing. 2.5% ($5,300) discount for cash payment or note paid within 90 days. Extra territory $1,110 per 1,000 population above the maximum. Conversion candidates may buy a smaller package (about $25,000 to $75,000).

royalty.flat: Fixed fee $45-$115 based on Your monthly Gross Volume; Minimum royalty fee $100 Monthly
royalty.quote: Royalty fee Currently ranges from 3% to 10% of Your monthly Gross Volume with a 10% cap ... Fixed fee $45-$115 based on Your monthly Gross Volume ... Minimum royalty fee $100 Monthly

adFund.quote: Brand Fund Fee 3% of Your monthly Gross Volume ... We may collect up to 3% of Your monthly Gross Volume as a Brand Fund Fee. Currently, we collect 2 ½ % of Your monthly Gross Volume (not including Gross Volume from Reduced Rate Services) subject to a "cap" of $1,550,000.
adFund.note: Currently 2.5%, up to 3%; 0.25% on Reduced Rate Services; contributions capped at $1,550,000 of Gross Volume. Local advertising at franchisee's discretion (no fixed minimum in Item 6).

otherRecurring.name: Software License and Technology Agreement (WorkCenter)
otherRecurring.amount: $200 per month per franchise license, beginning the 1st day of the third month after You sign

otherRecurring.name: Fixed fee (with royalty)
otherRecurring.amount: $45-$115 based on Your monthly Gross Volume

otherRecurring.name: Lead fee
otherRecurring.amount: A fee not to exceed $75 for each lead referred by Us and Our affiliates; additional fee not to exceed $50 per lead where the client pays Us

otherRecurring.name: Program fees on referred jobs
otherRecurring.amount: Servpro Disaster Response Program Fee 5% of your Gross Volume for each job; Commercial Select Program Fee up to 5%; Commercial Job Fee not to exceed 10% of total invoice

otherRecurring.name: Annual Convention registration
otherRecurring.amount: In-person and virtual registration fees per attendee (virtual $359 to $459), deducted from Convention Allowance if available

transferFee.amount: Up to $35,000 Before transfer is effective; Resale referral fee up to 10% of gross sales price if franchisor finds the buyer

item19.note: We do not make any representations about a franchisee's future financial performance or the past financial performance of company-owned or franchised outlets.

special: Royalty is a sliding scale on monthly Gross Volume (10% up to $13,196.99, then 9%, 8%, 7.5%, 7%, and marginal 6.5% down to 5% above $219,947), plus a $45-$115 monthly Fixed Fee; reconstruction work can qualify for Reduced Rate Royalty (5% until $43,989 year-to-date, then a declining scale starting at 4.5%). Jobs from national accounts, disaster response and commercial programs carry extra per-lead fees and 5%-10% program fees withheld by the franchisor, which collects payment from the client. Up to 10% of royalties may be returned as a Convention Allowance. $112,000 equipment package bought from an affiliate.
issues: Transfer fee printed as 'Up to $35,000' (maximum used). Royalty pct/pctHigh taken from the Item 6 range 3%-10% which includes Reduced Rate Services; core restoration services range 10% to 5%.
